description: Captured data from a batch password reset run. The debug log was accidentally left enabled, exposing CSRF nonces, tracking IDs, and audit IDs for all requests. The attacker controls the 'alice' and 'bob' accounts and received their reset tokens via email.

application_info.note: All requests in this batch were processed sequentially in a single PHP process. The PRNG was seeded once at process startup.

target: Determine the admin account's reset token and write it to /app/admin_token.txt
